outcomeNote: unit breaks off mid-suggestion; the rejection and answer follow in shabbat.sugya928

segments.he: כְּלָל אָמַר אַבָּא שָׁאוּל: כֹּל שֶׁאֲנִי וְכוּ׳. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: אַבָּא שָׁאוּל אַהֵיָיא? אִילֵּימָא אַרֵישָׁא קָאֵי: ״אֵין מַחְשִׁיכִין עַל הַתְּחוּם לִשְׂכּוֹר פּוֹעֲלִים לְהָבִיא פֵּירוֹת״ —
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «Abba Shaul stated a» general «principle:» With regard to «anything that I am» permitted to discuss on Shabbat, I am permitted to wait for nightfall at the edge of the Shabbat boundary for its sake. The Gemara raises a «dilemma: To which» part of the mishna did «Abba Shaul’s» statement «refer? If you say» that it «relates to the first clause» of the mishna, which taught: «One may not wait for nightfall at the» edge of the Shabbat boundary in order «to hire workers or to bring produce,»
